style: Game sprite for a dark, readable sci-fi 2D space shooter. Strict top-down orthographic view seen from directly above, the front/nose of the craft pointing to the RIGHT side of the image, centered, filling about 80% of the canvas, fully transparent background, no shadow on the ground, no text, no frame, crisp silhouette, painterly detailed hard-surface rendering with subtle rim light.

assets.prompt: Small agile human fighter spacecraft, sleek arrow-shaped hull, swept wings, steel-blue and white armor plates, cyan engine glow at the rear.
Heavy armored human tank spacecraft, wide boxy hull with thick layered plating, shield emitters on the sides, gunmetal and navy colors, cyan engine glow.
Human cargo hauler spacecraft, bulky cargo pods on both sides, industrial yellow-grey plating, small cockpit at the front, cyan engines.
Human cruiser spacecraft, long elegant hull with several laser turrets, white and steel-blue plating, cyan engines.
Massive human battlecruiser spacecraft, long armored hull bristling with laser turrets, dark steel and gold trim, multiple cyan engines.
Small insectoid alien craft of grey metal, six fins like legs, red cabin without glass, veins of black tissue between plates, spiky silhouette, cyan thrusters.
Irregular drone built from salvaged ship parts, asymmetric rotors and a frontal mechanical jaw, yellow lights, exposed cables.
Oval armored mass with overlapping plates, giant rivets and a central optical eye, two heavy side engines, brutal industrial look, rust and orange accents.
Narrow biomechanical fighter with a needle prow, beetle-like wings and black metallic segments, orange lines and small rear spines.
Compact craft with a huge rotating front drill, blackened yellow armor, two clamping arms and blue steam exhausts.
Floating hexagonal platform with antennas and three shield emitters, dark green metal, glowing blue core, folded mechanical legs.
Mechanical sphere with four curved claws, pulsing red center and small nozzles, like a metal flower about to open.
Scavenger craft with magnetic arms, external tanks and a prow shaped like a robotic skull, patched metal of different colors.
Triangular body with a large central cannon-lens and side stabilizers, graphite armor, red lens and deployable radiators.
Large industrial mothership with an open ventral hangar, riveted plates and rows of red lights.
Alien industrial spawning nest built into a rusty asteroid, glowing orange hatch openings, metal ribs and cables, seen from above, round shape.
